body:
CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Self-hosting: alloc non-literal value-argument support shipped (the 'necessary companion fix' named right after mid-body #target). concat's own real (alloc dest String (+ (length a) (length b))) now emits a genuinely, correctly-sized arena_alloc call instead of a silent zero-byte arena_strdup(dest,'',0). Confirmed live that nested-call binary-op arguments already worked (every-call-arg-symbol-or-number? already recurses) -- only alloc's own literal-only assumption was the real gap. Live-verified against stdlib/string.prn's own real length+concat source, self-compiled through parena-selfhost, running end to end. 6 new tests, all pass; full suite 347/347 + every selfhost domain + test-selfhost-cli clean, zero regressions (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
